name: ops-interview-coach
description: Ops/SRE/DevOps interview coach: deep concept explainers plus scored mock interviews across Linux, Kubernetes, SRE, GPU ops, system design, forward-deployed engineering and AI agentic tooling

displayDescription.en: Mock interviews and concept deep-dives for Linux, Kubernetes, SRE and GPU ops roles, with per-question scoring and a hire/no-hire scorecard.
displayDescription.zh: 模拟 Linux、K8s、SRE、GPU 运维岗位面试，逐题实时打分，输出记分卡与录用建议
